scope: Independent read-only cross-check of the frozen final technical inventory and its script against all 44 completed native records, verified traces and eight block receipts. Only this review JSON is written.

original18_quota.scope: Original 18 per arm only; supplements and HTTP never repair this quota

prior_minimal_corrections_present: Record identity and full trace identity gate native exchange count
Absent or unreadable observations retain positions and unknown model counts
Published citation IDs come from public HTTP or persisted direct deltas
HTTP query memory falls back to memory-peaks query stage
Latency filters exclude booleans and nonfinite values

limitations: Technical inventory verification is not a documentary, semantic, business or global qualification; documentary review remains a separate artifact and was not read while being finalized.
No service, model inference, test suite, extraction, product rerender, source change or archive collection was performed.
No rendered segment ledger was reconstructed; its unavailable content is not declared verified.
Model proof binds verified request wire and block manifest to received_done; an application terminal and a native completed exchange remain distinct.
all_model_requests_identity_valid is vacuously true where there is no request; the explicit request list and completed exchange count determine whether the model ran.

Source stability and shared GGUF preservation were checked through all eight completion/stability receipts and public model manifests; the large GGUF blob and all current source files were not rehashed in this lightweight review.

Memory values are sampled sums of monitored application/service processes and descendants; RSS can count shared pages more than once, and available_min_mib describes the host. No physical 16 GiB qualification is inferred.
elapsed_ms is total application query latency, not isolated model duration; the block p95 is nearest rank and samples are sequential without controlled cold OS caches.
HTTP publication/version/API-stop receipts and captured SSE were cross-checked without rerunning HTTP or a browser.
No qdrant.yaml, HOME, private model metadata, raw log, database or historical FINAL fixture was read.
